answer:
I rebuilt the Meal plan's App side so it fits an iPhone without sideways scrolling. I couldn't run check_app or preview_app, so I haven't viewed it at phone width.

The old layout was a table fixed at 900 px wide. Each day is now its own card, with Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snack listed under the day name. Days marked Shop = Yes get a "Shop" badge, and the Notes text shows at the bottom of the card. On a phone the cards stack in one column. On wider screens they sit in two or three columns.

The note's text and table are unchanged. The previous version of the App side is kept if you want it back.
